def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    mask = bins >= item
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    if np.any(mask):
        remaining_capacity = bins[mask] - item
        priorities[mask] = -np.exp(remaining_capacity)
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    target_fill_ratio = 0.7
    mask = bins >= item
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    remaining = bins[mask] - item
    target_remaining = (1 - target_fill_ratio) * bins[mask]
    priorities[mask] = -np.abs(remaining - target_remaining)
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    mask = bins >= item
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    priorities[mask] = -(bins[mask] / (bins[mask] - item))
